scope: Elliptic Gauss-sum prior art and target-orientation gate for the quadratic x-resolvent on prime-order rational subgroup
statement: Published universal elliptic Gauss-sum formulas compute character-invariant powers for small torsion primes and Frobenius eigenvalues. The quadratic x-resolvent R([d]G) differs by chi_r(d), while its square is independent of d; in the p=47, r=61 control R(G)^2=R(2G)^2=7. The published cost retains a term linear in ell and does not provide an oriented target evaluator at ell=r.
